name: Crawler
description: EXECUTION: INTAKE — reads a folder the browser has been given and turns it into a corpus: a pre-scan pie chart of what is in there, a deep crawl with AST parsing in WebAssembly, and an EVERYTHING.LOG plus a MAP.txt out the far end. Two halves in one repository, both real directories: Thin/ is this browser app (a Next.js static export) and Thick/ is the Tkinter desktop half. The app named here is a build artefact — Thin/out/ is generated by `npm run build` in Thin/ and untracked, so it must be built before the window can open. This file owns the stage (01 · Event): pipeline.json's _comment rules that an application's own display.json wins over the apps map.
